t: This is Hylas and the Nymph, a sculpture by Henry Alfred Pegram. Pegram, who lived from 1862 to 1937, was a British sculptor and an exponent of the New Sculpture movement. That was a lively late Victorian approach to British sculpture. The title points to the old myth of the youth Hylas and a water nymph. Take a moment to look at how the figures are modelled and how they relate to one another.
